featuredWork.moreWorkPageIntro: Every project — from product design to research and development.

projects.title: E-Commerce Redesign
projects.summary: A full storefront redesign focused on clearer product discovery, faster checkout, and a visual system that scales across campaigns.
projects.challenge: The existing shop buried categories, overloaded the homepage, and dropped users during checkout on mobile.
projects.outcome: Streamlined navigation, a modular product grid, and a checkout flow that cut drop-off in early testing.

projects.title: Wellness App
projects.summary: A calm, habit-first mobile experience that helps users build routines without feeling overwhelmed.
projects.challenge: Users wanted guidance but rejected rigid schedules and noisy notification patterns.
projects.outcome: Flexible daily goals, gentle reminders, and a progress view that rewards consistency over streaks.

projects.title: Fashion Lookbook
projects.summary: An editorial lookbook site that lets imagery lead while keeping collection browsing effortless.
projects.challenge: The brand needed a digital presence that felt premium but loaded quickly on mobile networks.
projects.outcome: Full-bleed editorial layouts, lazy-loaded galleries, and typography that mirrors the print campaign.

projects.title: Portfolio System
projects.summary: A custom portfolio built with intentional motion, scroll choreography, and a modular case-study structure.
projects.challenge: Off-the-shelf templates felt generic and fought against the brand’s editorial, high-contrast aesthetic.
projects.outcome: A bespoke site with pinned sections, project pages, and a design language that stays consistent end to end.

projects.title: Campaign Site
projects.summary: A launch microsite with bold typography, scroll-driven storytelling, and assets built for social cutdowns.
projects.challenge: The campaign had to work as a landing page, paid media destination, and press kit in one build.
projects.outcome: A single responsive system with reusable hero modules and export-ready visual blocks.

projects.title: Mobile Banking
projects.summary: Research and redesign of core banking flows to make transfers, bills, and balances feel immediate and trustworthy.
projects.challenge: Users distrusted the app after failed payments and unclear error states during peak usage.
projects.outcome: Clearer status feedback, simplified transfer steps, and a dashboard that surfaces what matters first.

overview.title: The problem and the solution.
overview.problemText: The existing wellness app pushed rigid schedules and noisy notifications. Users opened it once, felt overwhelmed, and never returned — daily habits never had room to form.
overview.solutionText: A calm, habit-first mobile experience with flexible daily goals, gentle reminders, and a progress view that rewards consistency over streaks — designed to feel supportive, not demanding.

myRole.title: What I specifically did.
myRole.intro: I led the end-to-end UX process on this project — from stakeholder interviews and competitive analysis through to high-fidelity UI and developer handoff.

insights.title: Rigidity repels
insights.text: Users abandoned the app when missed days reset their progress. Streaks felt punishing rather than motivating — flexibility was non-negotiable.

insights.title: Noise erodes trust
insights.text: Push notifications were the top uninstall trigger. People wanted fewer, better-timed nudges tied to goals they had actually set themselves.

insights.title: Progress must feel real
insights.text: Participants needed visible proof that small actions counted. Abstract metrics meant nothing — tangible weekly summaries drove retention.
